aka.en: Great River Road (for much of its length)
Airline Highway (New Orleans to Baton Rouge)
aka.zh: 航线公路（新奥尔良至巴吞鲁日）

tagline.en: Up the Mississippi from New Orleans to the edge of the Twin Cities, through the Delta where the blues were made
tagline.zh: 自新奥尔良沿密西西比河上溯至双子城边缘，穿过孕育蓝调的三角洲

start.zh: 路易斯安那州新奥尔良，与 US 90 相接

end.en: I-35 at Wyoming, Minnesota, north of St Paul
end.zh: 明尼苏达州怀俄明市，圣保罗以北，与 I-35 相接

en: US 61 follows the Mississippi for most of its length, from New Orleans to the northern suburbs of St Paul, through Louisiana, Mississippi, Tennessee, Arkansas, Missouri, Iowa, Wisconsin and Minnesota. It never enters Illinois: between Memphis and Dubuque it keeps to the west bank. Between the Jefferson–Orleans parish line and Baton Rouge it is the Airline Highway, a name that described the straight new road as against the winding Jefferson Highway along the levee, not the airport it later passed.

North of Vicksburg it crosses the Mississippi Delta through Leland, Clarksdale and Tunica, the country that gave it the name Blues Highway. The Mississippi Blues Trail has markers for the road at Vicksburg and Tunica; the old junction with US 49 in Clarksdale is the crossroads of the Robert Johnson legend; and the singer Bessie Smith died after a car crash on this stretch on 26 September 1937. Bob Dylan took the number for his album Highway 61 Revisited.

Above Memphis it is a road of river towns: under a 1924 concrete arch into Missouri, through Ste. Genevieve and on Lindbergh Boulevard round St Louis, then Hannibal, Keokuk, Burlington, Muscatine and Dubuque. It crosses into Wisconsin on the Dubuque–Wisconsin Bridge, runs inland by Lancaster and Fennimore to La Crosse, and follows the Minnesota bank through Winona and Red Wing to Hastings and St Paul.
zh: US 61 在大部分路程中沿密西西比河而行，自新奥尔良至圣保罗北郊，途经路易斯安那、密西西比、田纳西、阿肯色、密苏里、艾奥瓦、威斯康星与明尼苏达。它从不进入伊利诺伊：在孟菲斯与迪比克之间，它始终走河的西岸。从杰斐逊—奥尔良两堂区交界至巴吞鲁日，它叫“航线公路”——这个名字说的是这条笔直的新路有别于沿河堤蜿蜒的杰斐逊公路，而非它后来经过的机场。
维克斯堡以北，它经利兰、克拉克斯代尔与图尼卡穿过密西西比三角洲，“蓝调公路”之名即由此而来。密西西比蓝调之路在维克斯堡与图尼卡为这条路设有标志；克拉克斯代尔与 US 49 的旧交叉口就是罗伯特·约翰逊传说中的“十字路口”；歌手贝茜·史密斯于 1937 年 9 月 26 日在这一段遭遇车祸后身亡。鲍勃·迪伦把这个编号用作专辑《重访 61 号公路》的名字。
孟菲斯以上，它是一条串起河港小镇的路：穿过一座 1924 年的混凝土拱门进入密苏里，经圣吉纳维芙，沿林德伯格大道绕过圣路易斯，再经汉尼拔、基奥卡克、伯灵顿、马斯卡廷与迪比克。它经迪比克—威斯康星大桥进入威斯康星，取道内陆的兰开斯特与芬尼莫尔到拉克罗斯，再沿明尼苏达一侧河岸经威诺纳与雷德温到黑斯廷斯和圣保罗。

en: South of St Louis the road follows the line of El Camino Real, the Spanish colonial road requested in 1776 to join St Louis and Ste. Genevieve, reportedly built by 1779 and later carried south to Cape Girardeau and New Madrid. Kingshighway survives as a street name in several of those towns. When US 61 was numbered in 1926 it took over most of Missouri Route 9, laid out in 1922.

The original US 61 ran 1,714 miles, through Duluth and up the North Shore of Lake Superior to the Canadian border near Grand Portage. I-35 replaced it between the Twin Cities and Duluth, and in 1991 the northern end was cut back: the North Shore road became Minnesota Highway 61, and the stretch from Wyoming to Duluth was handed to local government or absorbed by I-35. Since 2012 Chisago, Pine and Carlton counties have marked the old line with OLD US 61 signs.

Elsewhere the road has been widened and moved rather than shortened. Iowa rebuilt Davenport to Dubuque as four lanes from the early 1980s, finishing in 1999, and in 2010 moved the route through Davenport onto I-280 and I-80 because of a low railway bridge downtown. In Mississippi the legalisation of casinos in 1990 and growth south of Memphis led to most of the road in Tunica and DeSoto counties being relocated and divided.

For much of its length US 61 is also signed as the Great River Road. The Mississippi River Parkway Planning Commission was formed in 1938 at the urging of the Interior Secretary, Harold Ickes; the Federal Highway Act of 1954 paid for route planning, and the pilot's-wheel markers appeared in the late 1950s. In 2021 the Federal Highway Administration named eight of the ten state Great River Road byways All-American Roads.
zh: 圣路易斯以南，这条路沿袭“皇家大道”的线位。这是西班牙殖民时期的道路，1776 年为连接圣路易斯与圣吉纳维芙而奏请修建，据称于 1779 年建成，后来向南延伸至吉拉多角与新马德里。“国王大道”至今仍是其中几座城镇的街名。1926 年 US 61 编号时，接管了 1922 年设立的密苏里 9 号公路的大部分路段。
最初的 US 61 全长 1,714 英里，经德卢斯沿苏必利尔湖北岸直抵大波蒂奇附近的加拿大边境。双子城至德卢斯之间被 I-35 取代；1991 年北端被截短：北岸公路改为明尼苏达 61 号州道，怀俄明至德卢斯一段或移交地方政府，或并入 I-35。自 2012 年起，奇萨戈、派恩与卡尔顿三县沿旧线竖立“OLD US 61”标志。
其余路段的变化是拓宽与改线，而非截短。艾奥瓦自 1980 年代初起把达文波特至迪比克改建为四车道，1999 年完工；2010 年又因市中心一座净空过低的铁路桥，把穿越达文波特的路线改走 I-280 与 I-80。在密西西比，1990 年赌场合法化，加上孟菲斯以南的发展，使图尼卡县与德索托县境内的大部分路段改线并修成分隔道路。
US 61 的大部分路段同时标为“大河路”。1938 年，在内政部长哈罗德·伊克斯的敦促下，密西西比河景观道规划委员会成立；1954 年《联邦公路法》为线路规划拨款，舵轮形标志于 1950 年代末出现。2021 年，联邦公路管理局将十个州的大河路风景道中的八个评为“全美道路”。

en: Like other 1926 routes, US 61 was numbered over roads the states had already built and has been paid for piece by piece since. The Great River Road is the one programme that put federal money into the corridor by name: from 1973 to 1982 Congress authorised $314 million for it, $251 million of it allocated directly to the states.

The largest single work on the road in recent years is the Hastings Bridge in Minnesota, a tied arch with a 545-foot main span that replaced the 1951 Hastings High Bridge. MnDOT brought the replacement forward after the I-35W bridge collapse in Minneapolis in August 2007; the design-build contract went to a Lunda and Ames joint venture for $119.83 million, the total is reported at $130 million, and all four lanes were open by November 2013.
zh: 与其他 1926 年的路线一样，US 61 是在各州已建成的道路上编号的，此后一直分段出资改建。唯有“大河路”这一项目以专名把联邦资金投入这条走廊：1973 至 1982 年，国会为其授权 3.14 亿美元，其中 2.51 亿美元直接拨给各州。
近年这条路上最大的单项工程，是明尼苏达州的黑斯廷斯大桥——一座主跨 545 英尺的系杆拱桥，取代了 1951 年的黑斯廷斯高桥。2007 年 8 月明尼阿波利斯 I-35W 大桥坍塌后，明尼苏达州交通部把换桥工程提前；设计—施工合同以 1.1983 亿美元授予 Lunda 与 Ames 的联合体，据报总造价 1.3 亿美元，四条车道于 2013 年 11 月全部通车。

why.en: No figure exists for the route. US 61 was numbered in 1926 over existing state roads, parts of them on the line of an eighteenth-century colonial road, and eight states have rebuilt it project by project since.
why.zh: 全线并无造价数据。US 61 于 1926 年沿各州既有道路编号，其中部分路段沿用十八世纪殖民道路的线位，此后由八个州逐个项目改建。

why.en: There is no single funder. Each state builds and maintains its own section with state and federal-aid highway money; the only federal programme tied to the corridor by name was the Great River Road funding of 1973–1982.
why.zh: 没有单一出资方。各州以州资金与联邦补助公路资金修建并养护本州路段；唯一以专名与这条走廊挂钩的联邦项目，是 1973 至 1982 年的大河路拨款。

value.en: $314 million authorised by Congress from 1973 to 1982, of which $251 million was allocated directly to the states
value.zh: 1973 至 1982 年国会授权 3.14 亿美元，其中 2.51 亿美元直接拨给各州

figures.source: English Wikipedia, Great River Road, history section

label.zh: 黑斯廷斯大桥（明尼苏达）

value.en: Design-build contract $119.83 million; total reported at $130 million; two lanes open June 2013, four lanes November 2013. Not checked against MnDOT's final accounts
value.zh: 设计—施工合同 1.1983 亿美元；据报总造价 1.3 亿美元；2013 年 6 月两车道通车，11 月四车道全通。未与明尼苏达州交通部决算核对

figures.source: English Wikipedia, Hastings Bridge, citing Architect Magazine

value.en: Reported at 1,406.99 miles in English Wikipedia, which gives no source; not checked against state route logs. The pre-1991 route is given there as 1,714 miles
value.zh: 英文维基百科称 1,406.99 英里，但未注出处；未与各州路线里程表核对。该条目称 1991 年以前的路线长 1,714 英里

why.en: Eight state agencies count US 61 separately, and in places its traffic is counted as I-55, I-80 or I-94 traffic because the routes share pavement. No combined figure is published.
why.zh: 8 个州的机构分别统计 US 61；部分路段与 I-55、I-80 或 I-94 共用路面，车流计入这些州际公路。并无合并数字发布。

timeline.en: The Spanish road between St Louis and Ste. Genevieve, El Camino Real, is reported complete; US 61 later follows its line.
timeline.zh: 据称连接圣路易斯与圣吉纳维芙的西班牙“皇家大道”建成，后来的 US 61 沿用其线位。

timeline.en: US 61 is numbered from New Orleans to the Canadian border near Grand Portage, Minnesota.
timeline.zh: US 61 编定，自新奥尔良至明尼苏达州大波蒂奇附近的加拿大边境。

timeline.en: Bessie Smith dies after a car crash on US 61 in the Mississippi Delta on 26 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 26 日，贝茜·史密斯在密西西比三角洲的 US 61 上遭遇车祸后身亡。

timeline.en: The Mississippi River Parkway Planning Commission is formed to plan what becomes the Great River Road.
timeline.zh: 密西西比河景观道规划委员会成立，规划日后的大河路。
鲍勃·迪伦发行专辑《重访 61 号公路》。

timeline.en: The route is cut back to Wyoming, Minnesota; the North Shore section becomes Minnesota Highway 61.
timeline.zh: 路线截至明尼苏达州怀俄明；北岸路段改为明尼苏达 61 号州道。

timeline.en: Iowa completes the four-lane highway from Davenport to Dubuque.
timeline.zh: 艾奥瓦建成达文波特至迪比克的四车道公路。

timeline.en: US 61 through Davenport is moved onto I-280 and I-80, the old line becoming a business route.
timeline.zh: 穿越达文波特的 US 61 改走 I-280 与 I-80，旧线改为商业支线。

timeline.en: The new Hastings Bridge opens, two lanes in June and all four in November.
timeline.zh: 新黑斯廷斯大桥通车：6 月开放两车道，11 月四车道全通。

timeline.en: Eight of the ten state Great River Road byways are named All-American Roads.
timeline.zh: 十个州的大河路风景道中有八个被评为“全美道路”。
